dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical convergence of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white to light grey, with a longitudinal pixel intensity gradient shifting from high-reflectance on the right lateral side to a darker slate-grey shade on the left.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey clusters localized on the dorsal surface toward the posterior peduncle.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the primary white regions and the shaded grey lateral zone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, elongated vertical linear mark with distinct contrast located on the cranial-dorsal plane, offset slightly to the right of the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible vertical linear scratch or scar on the upper dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined, dark-rimmed circular aperture of the blowhole at the anterior-most visible point of the dorsal plane.
